journal_authority_fix.finding: Local capabilities and asynchronous source health did not prove current credential authority. An already pending journal fact was re-exposed without acknowledgement after revocation. The deterministic original-server managed-helper regression fails before the fix.
journal_authority_fix.change: Public Rust delivery and managed helper release now perform a finite, same-permission conversation.subscribe read after the original cursor with live=false and limit1. The result must retain finite/non-resync semantics. This never acknowledges, advances or renews the original source and never changes original mutation IDs. Managed completed work is rechecked before serialization.
journal_authority_fix.after_fix: Four actual journal functions pass, including retained-fact revocation under both algorithms, original facts/audience/cursor, restart and renewal alongside decoded native audio. Complete installed Node/Python current-authority journeys pass. A closed original event source is recorded separately from a request error; neither may return a fact.

retained_failures.finding: First Node AV fixture read the remote publisher label for native audio. Current negotiated audio is the local mixed sink; video/data use the selected remote label. Corrected the receive handle; no API fallback or deadline change.
Both Python algorithms stopped at the same incorrect audio receive handle before decoded-media qualification. Corrected to the current local mixed-audio sink.

Concurrent Node/Python rehearsal exceeded the existing 15s initial control phase at events-bootstrap. Retained as failed. Later serial complete runs pass unchanged bounds; scheduler contribution was not separately quantified.

EdDSA completed including decoded AV; ES256 failed the pre-existing current-authority event assertion. A later deterministic retained-fact regression confirmed a real authorization gap; this aggregate remains failed.

A stricter EOF-versus-error check also failed at current authority. Returning an event remains forbidden. The shared helper was still capable of exposing a buffered fact after credential revocation; finite server reauthorization now guards release.

initial_codec_failure.finding: ASCII decoding stripped the high bit of an IVF codec tag. Exact binary comparisons now reject it; all8 component functions pass, also including receive-side assembly overflow independent of the sender limit.
